ideas.name: Parent Coin After Distribution
ideas.claim: A study reports negative abnormal returns for parent cryptocurrencies around hard-fork and airdrop distribution dates.
ideas.quote: The cumulative average abnormal return over the 5-day post-distribution date equals -12.29%.
ideas.mechanism: Price reaction of the parent coin around a hard-fork or airdrop distribution; selling pressure is not established by the quoted result.

rules.market: Parent cryptocurrencies of hard-forked or airdropped coins

ideas.claimed_result: Cumulative average abnormal return of -12.29% over the five-day post-distribution window; the study covers 67 events across 19 cryptocurrencies from 2014 to 2020.
required_data: Historical hard-fork and airdrop distribution dates
